title: Weight of the De Rham-Betti Structures of Abelian Varieties
summary: In this note, we prove that for any abelian variety defined over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$, its de Rham-Betti (dRB) group necessarily contains $\mathbb{G}_{m}$ as the group of homotheties. Consequently, this rules out the existence of non-zero dRB classes in odd-degree cohomology groups of abelian varieties over $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$. This generalises results of the first part of arXiv:2511.01072.
